string-array.name: focus_quotes
string-array.item: Later is an address that doesn\'t exist.
Every postponed hour is a loan, and anxiety is the interest.
The task is smaller than the dread it grows in the dark.
You\'re not tired. You\'re negotiating.
This minute will not be reissued.
A half-started thing weighs more than a finished one.
Distraction is discomfort wearing a nicer interface.
The feed has no bottom. Your afternoon does.
Ten minutes of real attention outweighs an hour of hovering.
Hovering over the work isn\'t the work.
Perfect conditions arrive shortly after the deadline.
Planning the plan is procrastination in a tie.
The wall is ninety seconds thick. Then it\'s a door.
Every yes to the scroll is a quiet no to something you named.
Minutes never ask what you meant to do with them.
Dread compounds faster than work does.
You already know the next step. It\'s just unglamorous.
Boredom is the toll on the road to depth.
The inbox refills. The hour doesn\'t.
What you delay, you still carry.
Attention is the one currency you can\'t earn back.
The urge to check is a wave. It passes if you don\'t paddle.
Rest is a decision. Avoidance is a leak.
Two hours of almost-starting cost the same as two hours of working.
Nobody remembers the hours they spent deciding.
The blank page has never bitten anyone.
Depth is stacked one uninterrupted stretch at a time.
Guilt is a terrible clock, but this one is honest.
The clock isn\'t against you. It just isn\'t waiting.
You don\'t need a better system. You need the next sentence.
Whatever you\'re avoiding gets quieter once you begin.
A day is 1,440 votes. Cast this one on purpose.
Avoiding still spends the time.
Comfort is cheap now and expensive later.
Finish one thing today that Friday never has to think about.
Your phone will be there in twenty-five minutes. It\'s patient.
Deadlines are just gravity with a date.
The dread lives in the delay, not in the task.
One clean hour is worth a scattered week.
Busy is a hiding place, and it\'s well furnished.
Every open tab is a small unmade decision.
Resistance points at the work that matters, like a compass with bad manners.
Years are just afternoons handled well or badly.
Procrastination borrows from a future self who never agreed to the terms.
Ambition without hours is a rumor.
A minute of dodging feels like relief and books like debt.
You can\'t save time, only choose who gets it.
Research is sometimes fear with a bibliography.
The hour you\'re in is the only one with your name on it.
Momentum has no memory. It only knows this minute.
